summary.zh-CN: Portable Service Apps 现在具备完整的受控能力、长期任务、AI 调用、开发工具与跨平台验收闭环。
summary.en-US: Portable Service Apps now provide a complete mediated capability set, background work, AI calls, developer tooling, and cross-platform acceptance closure.

title.zh-CN: 完整的 Portable App 能力
宿主中介的数据、文件、网络与 Secret
title.en-US: Host-mediated data, files, network, and secrets

body.zh-CN: Rust/WASM Component 可以使用 KV、SQLite、受控目录、域名白名单和调用时 Secret，同时保持包体可移植和权限可撤销。
body.en-US: Rust/WASM Components can use KV, SQLite, granted directories, domain allowlists, and per-call secrets while packages stay portable and permissions remain revocable.

body.zh-CN: 应用可运行可取消 Job、发送进度和流式结果、处理可重试事件，并通过已绑定插槽调用模型或 Agent。
body.en-US: Apps can run cancellable jobs, publish progress and streamed results, process retryable events, and call models or Agents through bound slots.

title.zh-CN: 同一实例贯通 Panel、Agent 与 CLI
title.en-US: One instance across Panel, Agent, and CLI

body.zh-CN: 三个入口复用同一份数据、权限和调用合同，并提供依赖配置、Secret 绑定、验收状态和证据导出命令。
body.en-US: All three entry points share data, permissions, and invocation contracts, with CLI commands for dependencies, secrets, acceptance status, and evidence export.

body.zh-CN: 开发、产品和发布流程消费同一验收合同；跨平台产物必须携带当前版本与场景的真实证据才能发布。
body.en-US: Development, product, and release flows consume one acceptance contract; cross-platform artifacts must carry current-version, current-scenario evidence before publication.
